description: Human-verified sentence readings from spot-check audit

failure_patterns.positive_inflation: DOMINANT FAILURE. Common words (grant, goals, pass, bearing, returned, preserved, please) carry residual positive dV from V1 vocabulary. Neutral prose reads positive across ALL corpora.
failure_patterns.slang_blindness: Twitch hype markers (BABYYYYY, yurrrrrr, ITS SO GOOD) invisible. Discourse markers (no we good) misread as negation.
failure_patterns.sarcasm_on_real_text: Political anger, film criticism, coded insults read positive. Engine misses sarcasm without explicit markers.
failure_patterns.literary_complexity: Long subordinate-clause sentences trigger false structure detections (SARCASM_INVERSION, SOCIAL_NULLITY).
failure_patterns.procedural_inflation: Quest/instruction text (grant access, please head to) reads positive due to polite vocabulary.
